title: School
goal: Talk about your school day, your subjects, and ask for help in class.
goal_pt: Falar do seu dia na escola, das suas matérias, e pedir ajuda na aula.

reading.title: A day at Ana's school
reading.text: Ana's school day starts at seven thirty, because it is very hot in the afternoon. Her first lesson is math, which she likes, and then science, which she loves. At nine thirty there is a twenty minute break. Ana usually eats a banana and plays football in the playground with her friends. After the break there are two more lessons, and school finishes at midday. In the afternoon Ana does her homework, and then she is free. On Friday there is no homework, and that is her favorite day of the week.

options: It is very hot in the afternoon
